# optimizelycmp_publishing_channel (Data Source)

Looks up one publishing channel by name. It fails if there is no match or more than one.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Channel name (case-insensitive exact match).

### Read-Only

- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) ID of the publishing channel.
